name: Gerjen (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of red and blue at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Gerjen (a red and blue shield with a patriarchal cross, an anchor and a wavy stripe) above a yellow scroll inscribed GERJEN.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
